hash_rule: Every *_bytes field is an exact octet sequence written with literal markers: <BOM> = U+FEFF encoded UTF-8, <CRLF> = 0x0D 0x0A, <LF> = 0x0A, <NBSP> = U+00A0. source_hash = SHA-256 over those exact octets with no normalization. The oracle asserts hash stability and the inequality of source/normalized/rendered hashes; it never asserts a magic literal.
